# Pregnancy Ultrasound Evaluation(Archived)

**Authors:** Cayla C. Ulrich, Olga Dewald

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The use of ultrasound in the setting of pregnancy is vast and has become the standard of care in the evaluation of pregnant women. The average number of ultrasounds performed during pregnancy has increased from 1.5 in 1995 to 1997 to 2.7 from 2005 to 2006, with even higher numbers of ultrasound studies obtained for high-risk pregnancies. The use of ultrasound during pregnancy is growing and is utilized in both routine monitoring as well as in an acute setting of trauma or pregnancy complications.
